items.title: Normalize the signed Gaussian expectation

source.label: Zhou–Suzuki, Eq. (21)–(24): normalization bridge
source.anchor: Appendix B.2.2 Proposition B.7 proof: Eq21 plus Eq22–23 and the real-power prefactor substitution preceding Eq24 in A2.SS2.SSS2.p5
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. This is the source-implicit positive real-power normalization joining Eq21 and Eq23, before the Poisson value is substituted in Eq24. Kernel absolute integrability and coefficient algebra are explicit here.
source.scope: Normalized actual signed Gaussian expectation and absolute Haar integrability of its normalized scalar kernel. No sphere pushforward, either Poisson integral evaluation, Eq24 evaluated H, actual positive TV first ratio, amplification, oracle/query/cost, hidden-eigenbasis or main bounds. The source-omitted real-power scaling and normalized kernel L1 are supplied internally, not hypotheses.

items.statement: For natural \(n\ge3\) and real \(\kappa\ge4\), put \(s=\sqrt\kappa\), \(r=(1-1/n)(s-1)/(s+1)\) and \(\ell=(4ns+(s-1)^2)/(8n(n-1))\). Let \(\mu\) be normalized Haar probability on full \(O(n)\), \(U=O_{11}\), \(A_O=((\kappa+1)/2)I-((\kappa-1)/4)(O+O^\top)\), and \(\gamma_O=\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})\) on actual Euclidean space. Define \(q(O)=((s+1)U-(s-1))/(1+r^2-2rU)^{n/2}\), with real half-dimension powers. Then \(q\in L^1(\mu)\) and \(\mathbb E_\mu[\det(O)\int e^{-\ell\|x\|_2^2}\,d\gamma_O]=[(-1)^{n-1}(s-1)^{n-1}/(s+1)^n](1-1/n)^{n/2}\mathbb E_\mu q\). Positivity and all required domains and L1 are proved internally; no sphere law or Poisson value is assumed.
assumptions: Exactly natural \(n\ge3\) and real \(\kappa\ge4\), including \(\kappa=4\). All divisions involving \(n\) are real after coercion; \(n/2\) is a real exponent, including odd dimensions.

\(\mu\) is the unchanged normalized Haar probability on full \(O(n)\), with both determinant signs. \(U=O_{11}\) is its actual matrix coordinate; \(\gamma_O\) is the canonical Gaussian with covariance \(A_O^{-1}\).
\(r,\ell\) are the literal selected parameters. Their positivity, the actual-coordinate denominator positivity and absolute integrability of \(q\) are conclusions, never caller assumptions.
